Automation: Rules reference · play automation in progress

You answer the stranger in the language of their childhood, and hear their surprise give way to recognition.

Rules

Action
Passive
Attribute
None — no roll
Target / range / shape
Self
Duration
Permanent knowledge of the chosen language.
Equipment / acquisition
None.
Limits
Purchase once; choose one language when learned.
Type
Skill / Utility

When you learn this ability, choose one ordinary language you do not already know. You can speak and understand it, and read and write its usual script if it has one. Record the language on your sheet. A signed language uses signing instead of speech. Choose from the campaign’s ordinary languages with the DA; this grants no secret or supernatural language.
